source.directorySummary: Renders file diff web UI: stylesheet defines diff block and line styles, renderer builds diff card and timeline output with breadcrumb, line-numbered patch, and git-state notices.

context.value: plugins/file — workspace file-manager plugin in AppWeaver system: tree browsing, view/edit/create/delete/rename/restore, git diff/history/commit/restore/init, NIP-44/Blossom encrypted upload/download, and bottom-up docs via centralized dispatcher + plugin registration + AI tooling + fuzzy-file-search; ai complete (Zod-validated bottomup.generate/enrich/summarize/summary contracts, runtime dispatch via workspace root, in-memory DB); commands complete container (20 CLI/web subcommands: bottomup workflows with coverage validation/effective context/hash-cache/recursive/one-level/plan-draft-accept and index validation/projections, filesystem ops with size/binary/IGNORE/.gitignore filtering via ripgrep, git ops, secure transfer with naddr/NIP-44/integrity handling, shared workspace-root validation/filter/renderer/help under containment); types complete (adapter param contracts); no missing/stale coverage.

enrichment.directorySummary: Stateless web-presentation leaf beneath plugins/file/commands/diff, invoked only on the web path to materialize already-resolved diff results. Completes the parent read-only inspection leaf's validate-containment/repository-resolution → execute → adapt pattern by owning all web-channel rendering while CLI formatting stays in the parent adapter, and follows the plugin-wide stylesheet + renderer split as a terminal, logic-free view layer with no children or git/filesystem dependencies.

files.stylesheet.ts: Declarative style contract for the diff presentation leaf; registers WebStyleSheet id 'file-plugin-diff' for consumption by web.ts and the AppWeaver shell. Provides no runtime logic, decoupling visual semantics for patch/table/line-variant and breadcrumb/timeline elements from truncation, binary, and repository-resolution handling in the parent command.
files.web.ts: Imperative web-channel builder that translates diff execution outputs into WebNodeRoot/timeline_event trees for the shell. Counterpart to CLI rendering in the parent adapter, depends on stylesheet.ts for styling, and branches across single-file vs timeline/commit variants to handle truncated/binary metadata, breadcrumb headers, line-numbered patch tables with clipboard links, and git_unavailable/init error states.
